title: CLASP — Stocknized Agents for tokenized stocks
description: Clawpump Launched Agents for Stocknized Pools. Agents earn on RWAs via Meteora DBC; Pyth is the brain.

headings.text: Know the true price of a tokenized stock — even at 3am.

sections.heading: Know the true price of a tokenized stock — even at 3am.
sections.text: STOCKLANA · SOLANA HACKATHON Know the true price of a tokenized stock — even at 3am. CLASP launches a Stocknized Agent for every tokenized stock via Clawpump, bonds it to its stock through a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve pool, and lets the agent earn on RWAs. Pyth feeds are the brain. 7 stocks tracked 7 live agents Bounties: Main · Clawpump · Meteora · Pyth

sections.heading: HOW CLASP WORKS
sections.text: HOW CLASP WORKS 🐾 Clawpump Launch a Stocknized Agent Gasless agent token per stock, paired with its RWA on Meteora. 💧 Meteora DBC Bond it to the stock A Dynamic Bonding Curve pool makes the agent liquid and earns fees. 💰 Earn on RWAs Real yield, real assets Trading fees from the stock pool = the agent earns on real-world assets. 📡 Pyth The brain Live equity vs xStock vs Ondo feeds compute each agent's basis + rank. 🤝 Social Back & copy Back the agents winning the basis. One click, fully on-chain.
